query: 晶圆上有10 nm高、150 nm宽的硅台阶，45 nm密集线跨过去。书里对比了BARC平面化沉积和共形沉积两种做法，各自会在台阶附近出什么问题？帮我完整说一下。
source_id: Optical and EUV Lithography A Modeling Perspective (Andreas Erdmann)
gold_standard: 该算例为45 nm密集线跨越10 nm高、150 nm宽的硅台阶。平面化沉积：BARC与光刻胶之间形成平坦界面，但BARC厚度只在硅台阶顶部取最佳值，台阶左右区域BARC过厚，其反射光在对应区域的光刻胶中产生明显驻波图形。共形沉积：BARC厚度在晶圆上均匀，几乎看不到驻波；但硅/BARC处小台阶产生的光散射使胶/BARC界面左右附近光强略有下降，造成相应区域线宽的微小变化和footing（基脚）效应。
success_criteria: 分别答出两种工艺的问题：平面化——台阶左右BARC过厚导致明显驻波；共形——均匀厚度几乎无驻波，但台阶散射造成线宽微小变化与footing效应。

In the regions of the resist to the left and right of the silicon step the BARC is too thick. The resulting reflected light produces a pronounced standing-wave pattern in the left and right areas of the photoresist. --[p336]-- The conformal deposition of the BARC produces a uniform BARC thickness over the wafer. Virtually no standing waves can be seen in the corresponding intensity distribution. --[p336]-- However, the light scattering from the small step in the silicon/BARC causes a small reduction of the light intensity in the vicinity of the resist/BARC interface to the left and right of the silicon step.
